latest_release.name: v0.13.0
latest_release.body:
<details>
<summary>中文版</summary>

## 新功能

1. 全屏模式缩放下存在黑边时支持更改输出画面位置 (#1306、#973)
2. 添加截图快捷键，默认为 Alt+Shift+S (感谢 @freeze-dolphin) (#1436、#1288)
3. 支持截图文件名自定义，支持使用窗口标题、时间等参数 (#1463、#1297)
4. 支持在缩放时保持屏幕常亮 (#1455、#1444)
5. 为配置文件的导航菜单添加了右键菜单来快捷启动和删除 (#1464)

## 新效果

1. SGSR (感谢 @hooke007) (#1266): 移植自 [Snapdragon Game Super Resolution v1](https://github.com/SnapdragonGameStudios/snapdragon-gsr/tree/main/sgsr/v1)，这个一个非常轻量级的 3D 画面缩放算法
6. k7_modernAnime_FHD_x2 (感谢 @hooke007) (#1400): 适合动漫类风格的超分算法
7. Ani4Kv2_ArtCNN_C4F32_i (感谢 @XIONGPEILIN) (#1415): 又一个动画风格超分算法，移植自 https://github.com/Sirosky/Upscale-Hub/releases/tag/Ani4K-v2

## 修复

1. 修复启动参数文本框无法键入空格的问题 (#1376、#1371)
2. 优化了窗口模式缩放的可靠性 (#1335、#1356)
3. 修复了 Win10 中的内存泄露 (#1355)
4. 提高了保存配置文件的可靠性 (#1439)

## 其他更改

1. 更新翻译 (感谢翻译贡献者们！)
6. 删除了已废弃的 CuNNy 族
7. 优化可执行文件的版本号信息 (感谢 @Howard20181) (#1344)
8. 优化了一些效果的性能

## 面向开发者

现在编译项目的要求如下：
* Visual Studio 2026
* Windows SDK 26100 的最新版本
* Python 3.14
* 不再需要安装 CMake
 

</details>

## New Features

1. Support changing the output alignment when there are black borders in fullscreen scaling (#1306, #973)
2. Added a screenshot hotkey, defaulting to Alt+Shift+S (thanks @freeze-dolphin) (#1436, #1288)
3. Added support for customizing screenshot filenames (#1463, #1297)
4. Added an option to keep the display awake while scaling (#1455, #1444)
5. Added a context menu to the profile navigation menu for quickly launching and deleting profiles (#1464)

## New Effects

1. SGSR (thanks @hooke007) (#1266): Ported from [Snapdragon Game Super Resolution v1](https://github.com/SnapdragonGameStudios/snapdragon-gsr/tree/main/sgsr/v1). A very lightweight upscaling algorithm designed for 3D content
2. k7_modernAnime_FHD_x2 (thanks @hooke007) (#1400): An upscaling algorithm designed for anime-style content.
3. Ani4Kv2_ArtCNN_C4F32_i (thanks @XIONGPEILIN) (#1415): Another anime-oriented upscaling algorithm, ported from https://github.com/Sirosky/Upscale-Hub/releases/tag/Ani4K-v2

## Fixes

1. Fixed an issue where spaces could not be entered in the `Launch parameters` text box (#1376, #1371)
2. Improved the reliability of windowed mode scaling (#1335, #1356)
3. Fixed a memory leak on Windows 10 (#1355)
4. Improved the reliability of saving configuration file (#1439)

## Other Changes

1. Updated translations (thanks to all localization contributors!)
2. Removed the deprecated CuNNy family of effects
3. Improved executable version information (thanks @Howard20181) (#1344)
4. Improved the performance of several effects

## For developers

The requirements for building the project are now:

* Visual Studio 2026
* The latest version of Windows SDK 26100
* Python 3.14
* CMake is no longer required
